Zveniachyn Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Chernivtsi Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Zveniachyn's first two Jewish families settled in the 18th century, and the community organized formally in the first half of the 19th, building a synagogue and this cemetery in the 1830s. About 30 Jews emigrated to Palestine in the years before the war. In autumn 1941, Zveniachyn's Jews were deported to the Chernivtsi ghetto; many later perished during the construction of the Kamenetz-Podolsk labor camp, to which they were expelled in 1942. According to the record's own account, this cemetery was partly demolished during WWII.
